Stabilize automatic runtime recovery (#175)

* fix(runtime): cap runtime unknown retries

Bound owner-deterministic recovery by immutable committed receipts. Leave Attention open after three retries instead of spawning unbounded provider processes.

* fix(runtime): replay quarantined revisions

Resume exact Revision completion recoveries from durable callback authority without rerunning the Agent runtime. Provider conversation replay reads back deterministic receipts and fails closed on evidence drift.

* fix(runtime): schedule quarantined replays

Keep exact completion-replay recoveries eligible after the original runtime-unknown attention has been resolved and a provider-response attention remains open.
